description: Vegas Guide is an independent Las Vegas travel guide, not a booking site. Ask it anything about a Vegas trip: it answers with fact-checked advice from its own editorial guides (planning, budgets, itineraries, honest comparisons like which Cirque show or hotel to pick), current Las Vegas news (openings, closings, residencies), and a curated catalog of 174 shows and concerts, 121 hotels, 130 attractions, 69 tours, plus restaurants, bars, nightclubs and pools - every entry reviewed editorially with honest prices, insider tips and downsides included. It can also tell you what's near any point in the city.
